subject: Cascade onboarding: additional silos & governance plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cobaltworks.io>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cascade onboarding: additional silos & governance plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, CobaltWorks is looking to expand Redwood access from the initial Analytics team into three additional silos (Payments, Support AI, and Search experiments) over the next two quarters. Before I draft the amendment, two quick items I want to confirm:

1) Targeted rollouts: Payments (Sept), Support AI (Oct), Search (Nov). Are those windows still accurate?
2) API keys & environments: you mentioned wanting separate keys per project and a staging/production split — any constraints from your side on key naming or rotation cadence?

If that matches your expectations I’ll loop in Marissa (onsite enablement) and Karthik (your account exec) to coordinate the SOW/workflow and term adjustments. I’ll also attach a first-pass SLA and a draft SOW for review — can you confirm who on procurement should get the DocuSign?

Thanks — plan to have a draft amendment and proposed key governance by Friday.

Best,
Naomi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Cobalt_Onboarding_SLAs.pdf)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cobaltworks.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade onboarding: additional silos & governance plan

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — those windows look good. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Payments: need PCI scope called out (we will share the engineer who owns PCI).
- Support AI: will require a lower-burst latency target for certain endpoints (chat-style).
- Search experiments: likely lower volume initially, but will spin up quickly after internal alpha.

For keys: procurement prefers a predictable naming pattern: cw-<project>-env-<region> and rotation every 90 days unless otherwise negotiated. Procurement contact is procurement@cobaltworks.io (copying below).

Procurement will need a revised term that aligns with our fiscal calendar (starts Oct 1) — if that requires a short bridge amendment, happy to review. Please loop in the relevant folks.

Cheers,
Elena
Head of Platforms, CobaltWorks

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@cobaltworks.io>, procurement@cobaltworks.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade onboarding: additional silos & governance plan

Thanks Naomi — jumping in with a rollout/ops plan draft. High level:

- Key provisioning: we will issue keys per project + env. Proposed pattern: cw-<project>-<env>-<region>-<shortid> (examples in attached guide). Each key scoped to routes (generation vs embeddings) to limit blast radius.
- Staging vs Prod: staging keys will be rate-limited to < 25% of prod throughput and flagged for automated purge after 60 days of inactivity.
- Rotation: default 90 days; for PCI-heavy Payments project we can set 30-day rotation and automate via the KMS integration.
- Capacity uplift: sample commit for Payments: 2x dedicated GPUs (p4d equivalent) for Sept-Oct pilot, then re-evaluate based on token usage and latency metrics.
- Observability: we’ll provision per-key dashboards in the Console and a shared Drive folder with baseline prompt sets for quality checks.

Action items for CobaltWorks: share the PCI contact and any compliance questionnaire (if you want, we can pre-populate answers). Procurement — please confirm the DocuSign recipient for the amendment (if different from procurement@cobaltworks.io).

Attachment: api-key-naming-guide.md (contains examples, automation scripts, and a short policy)

Marissa
Technical Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cobaltworks.io>, procurement@cobaltworks.io
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade onboarding: additional silos & governance plan

Elena / procurement team —

Following the technical plan below, I’ve prepared two pricing/term options and attached an amendment draft. Summary:

Option A — Align to CobaltWorks fiscal calendar (Oct 1 start), 12-month term, staged capacity commit: 2x GPUs for Payments pilot + on-demand burst for Support AI. Includes 10% volume discount for the add-on teams.
Option B — 24-month term with a deeper committed discount (18%) and automated key rotation tooling included at no additional cost.

Both options include the staged provisioning schedule Marissa outlined and SLA addendum for the Support AI low-latency endpoints. If procurement prefers a bridge (Sept 15 — Sept 30) we can add a short-term credit to cover the gap.

Next steps: I’ve attached the SOW + amendment with track changes. If everything looks good we can send DocuSign to procurement@cobaltworks.io (or an alternate recipient you specify). I’ll be available for a quick call tomorrow morning to walk through numbers.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Payments into testing.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redistributed Revenue (Sales)
Redwood Inference
